notes: Reconciled by hand from the five legacy one-function sources; see the file's own header comment for the full measurement. The destructor is NOT written in the TU: it is inline in the class body in include/daObjUkiyuka_c.h and this TU owns the class's key function (Behavior, the first out-of-line virtual), so the compiler emits _ZTV14daObjUkiyuka_c and the D1/D0 pair it references. The two legacy shards' EmitDestructor / EmitDeletingDestructor forcing functions are dropped: in a merged TU the vtable already odr-uses both variants, and the forcers only added two source-written .text sections promotion cannot license.

NOT PROMOTED, and the blocker is destructor EMISSION ORDER, not bytes. The cartridge orders D0 (0x020b6388, 0x58) below D1 (0x020b63e0, 0x44) as the first two functions of the range; mwccarm emits the pair D1 then D0. Five source forms were measured, one compile each: inline dtor with deferred codegen (default), the same with the two forcers swapped, the same with the destructor declared last in the class, and inline dtor under `#pragma defer_codegen off` all give D1, D0 (the first three at the front of the object, the last at the end). Only an out-of-line destructor gives D0, D1.

THE OUT-OF-LINE FORM IS REFUTED BY THE CARTRIDGE. Moving ~daObjUkiyuka_c out of line makes descendants call it instead of inlining its vptr store: ov045/daObjKm2_Ukishima_c, already landed and byte-verified, drops from 5/5 to 3/5 with `999 word(s) differ` (a size disagreement) on both _ZN19daObjKm2_Ukishima_cD1Ev and _ZN19daObjKm2_Ukishima_cD0Ev, plus one wrong relocation destination (data_020a0eac != 0x020112c8:arm9). The inline form in the header is load-bearing and was restored.

Under `#pragma defer_codegen off` the pair follows the REVERSE of its first odr-use within one function's codegen, so one function containing `p->~daObjUkiyuka_c(); delete p;` does emit D0 then D1 -- but after that function's own section, and the cartridge puts the pair first in the range. A `static inline` helper is never codegen'd and never instantiates the variants at all (measured). Every remaining route costs a source-written .text section ahead of the pair, which compiler_only_output may not launder: it is an allow-list for compiler-generated output.

NEXT STEP IS A SLICING QUESTION, NOT A CODEGEN ONE. The left TU boundary is tu_map `medium`. If the original TU began at 0x020b6244 (the currently unattributed three-function run ahead of it) the destructor pair would sit mid-range, where an odr-use in a preceding member reproduces the cartridge's order with no extra section. Test that before trying further source forms.
